title: Data Factory job definition
description: JSON Schema (draft-07) of a Data Factory job.json. Derived from the job schema shipped by the Product-Live VS Code extension (Copyright (c) 2023 Product-Live, MIT License): snippets removed, two alpha exchange tasks added, the seven documented user input types and version added. The public documentation at https://learn.product-live.com/data-factory/ is the authority when the two disagree.
$comment: Derived from the job schema of the Product-Live VS Code extension, then corrected with what the public documentation states.

schema.description: Schema version of the job definition. Must be set to "1.0".

key.description: The unique key of the job in your account. It cannot be updated once the job is created. Best practice: lower case words separated by hyphens, for example my-first-job.

icon.description: The icon displayed to users (the public examples also use brain for AI jobs).

titleLocal.description: Localized titles keyed by ISO 639-3 language code (ara, zho, eng, fra, deu, hin, ita, jpn, kor, nld, por, rus, spa).

description.description: The functional description of this task in your job.

descriptionLocal.description: Localized descriptions keyed by ISO 639-3 language code (ara, zho, eng, fra, deu, hin, ita, jpn, kor, nld, por, rus, spa).

userInputs.description: Form fields presented to the user when the job is started from the application. Values are read in tasks with ${workflow.input.<key>}.

key.description: A unique key in the job. The key will be used for wiring user inputs and job inputParameters, for example: ${workflow.input.my_user_input_key}. All user inputs are referenced with ${workflow.input.your_custom_key}

title.description: The input label that will be displayed to the user.

description.description: The description of the user input that will be displayed to the user.

type.description: The user input type: TEXT, TEXTAREA, SELECT, FILE, DATE, FIELD or SCREEN. TEXT, SELECT and FILE are the long-standing types; the other four are documented more recently.

required.description: Define if the user input must be required.

multiple.description: Default false. When true the user can add several entries and the job receives an array.

default.description: Default value used when the user does not change the field. For SELECT, the key of the default option.

mode.description: Number of selectable options: SINGLE (default) or MULTIPLE.

key.description: A unique key in options. The key will be used as a output of the user selection.

title.description: The option label that will be displayed to the user.

titleLocal.description: The option label that will be displayed to the user. It's a key value object where key are ISO 639-3 restricted to the same values than import table task. For example: fra | eng

fra.description: It's a key value object where key are ISO 639-3 restricted to the same values than import table task. For example: fra | eng

eng.description: It's a key value object where key are ISO 639-3 restricted to the same values than import table task. For example: fra | eng

deu.description: It's a key value object where key are ISO 639-3 restricted to the same values than import table task. For example: fra | eng

options.description: Filtering of the fields proposed in the dropdown.

field.description: The field property to filter on: dataType, key, title, status or any other property of the field object.

value.description: A string for most operators, or an array of strings for in.

tasks.description: Ordered list of tasks that define the execution flow of the job.

outputParameters.description: User outputs: a map of labels to task outputs, typically "${<taskReferenceName>.output.<name>}" strings.

version.description: Optional free-text version of the job definition, for example "1.2.0". Document changes in CHANGELOG.md.

task.description: A task of the job: a catalog task (type SUB_WORKFLOW) or a flow-control task (SWITCH, DO_WHILE, TERMINATE, SET_VARIABLE, WAIT, or the deprecated DECISION).

name.description: For a catalog task, the task name from the catalog (for example table-export-items). For a flow-control task, a free label (the type is what matters).

taskReferenceName.description: The unique name of the task in your job, unique across nested branches too. Recommended style: lower case words separated by underscores, for example export_items.

description.description: The functional description of this task in your job.

optional.description: Defines what happens if an error occurs on the task. false: if the task has an error, the job is stopped in error. true: if the task has an error, the other tasks of the job are nevertheless executed.

type.description: The task type. SUB_WORKFLOW for every catalog task; SWITCH, DO_WHILE, TERMINATE, SET_VARIABLE, WAIT for flow control; DECISION is deprecated.

inputParameters.description: The input parameters of the task.

anyOf.description: A custom task of an account, named <account>/<key>.

evaluatorType.description: value-param: the value of the inputParameters key named by expression selects the case. javascript: expression is a JavaScript expression over $.<inputKey> whose result selects the case (these skills recommend ES5 syntax; the documentation states no language version).

expression.description: With value-param, the name of the inputParameters key to evaluate. With javascript, the expression to evaluate.

decisionCases.description: Map of possible values to the list of tasks executed for that value.

defaultCase.description: Tasks executed when no case matches. Always declare it, even empty.

caseValueParam.description: Name of the inputParameters key whose value selects the case. Deprecated: use a SWITCH task.

loopCondition.description: JavaScript expression evaluated after every iteration; the loop continues while it is true (these skills recommend ES5 syntax; the documentation states no language version). Inputs are reachable as $.<inputKey> and the iteration as $.<taskReferenceName>['iteration'].

terminationStatus.description: COMPLETED ends the job in success, FAILED ends it in error.

outputParameters.description: The user outputs displayed when the job ends here (the job-level outputParameters are not shown).

duration.description: For example "2 days 3 hours" or "1 hour 30 minutes". Exclusive with until.

until.description: A date such as "2025-12-25 09:00 CEST" or "2025-12-25". Exclusive with duration.

inputParameters.description: A map of variable names to values (string, number, boolean, array or object). Read them with ${workflow.variables.<name>}.
